providers.name: Affect Therapeutics

claims.detail: Says it accepts Medicaid; program 'covered by many Medicaid and commercial insurance plans'
Says it accepts 'many commercial insurance plans'; '90% of our members' pay nothing (provider claim)

providers.enrollmentProcess: Download the Affect app; Affect says it will check insurance coverage in minutes. Members are assigned a care team (licensed counselor, medical provider, care advocate) with weekly 1:1 counseling and twice-weekly group sessions, plus cash rewards tied to completed tasks and negative drug/alcohol screens.

providers.name: Bicycle Health

claims.detail: Says it accepts most major commercial insurance plans; most insured patients pay under $35/month (provider claim)
Says it accepts Medicare (incl. Medicare Advantage in some states)
Medicaid accepted only in some states; Medicaid/Medicare page lists plans for AZ, CO, MI, NE, OR. State pages say Medicaid not accepted in FL and no Medicaid partnerships in CA.

providers.enrollmentProcess: A licensed provider meets the patient by video and can send a buprenorphine/Suboxone prescription to a local pharmacy the same day. Ongoing care runs through a secure app (video, voice, chat, scheduling, drug screens).

providers.name: Monument

claims.detail: Says it accepts many major plans; $25 video appointments for therapy and medical visits when insurance is accepted (provider claim, page may be dated)

providers.enrollmentProcess: Users check insurance eligibility online with name and date of birth; after an initial call a Monument physician may prescribe naltrexone or disulfiram. Plans include Physician Care and Total Care (adds weekly or bi-weekly therapy).
